title: Shedlock pause experiment: two oral-script variants
purpose: Test package for isolating the pause as a narrative artifice, per Shedlock chapter III (art_01M6Q4XGAD1APP14J3B3QBP024, revision 1). Two script variants of the same 70-word scene: Version A uses no pause markers; Version B inserts pause notation at three structurally identical beats. All other variables held fixed. Intended for read-aloud comparison with listeners rating suspense and engagement after each version.
attribution: Shedlock, Marie L. The Art of the Story-Teller, chapter III — claims attributed and paraphrased, not quoted. Project Gutenberg eBook 5957, captured 2026-11-05. Source record: art_01M6Q4XGAD1APP14J3B3QBP024 revision 1.
